title: Cebu's Cabañero, Pasilang kickstart Asian Games campaign with wins

blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines—Gilas Pilipinas made a strong opening statement in the 3×3 basketball competitions of the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games 2026, with both the men’s and women’s teams scoring impressive wins over Mongolia on Monday, September 21. Cebuano players Nic Cabañero and Maria Pasilang were part of the winning Philippine squads, helping Gilas Pilipinas make an early mark in the Asian Games 3×3 competitions. The Gilas men, composed of players from the UAAP and MPBL, opened their Group A campaign with a 19-12 victory over Mongolia. They then completed a 2-0 start with a 21-12 win over Sri Lanka.
